ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a vertical straight wire AB, with A above and B below, and the direction of current I in the wire is upward. On the right side is a vertically placed rectangular closed coil abcd, with ab on the left and dc on the right, and OO′ is the vertical axis of symmetry of the coil. The straight wire AB is on the left side of OO′, and the dashed line in the figure indicates that the plane containing AB and OO′ is perpendicular to the plane of the coil. Reasoning: Convert the figure into a top view. The current in the straight wire is upward, equivalent to the current coming out of the plane of the paper in the top view. According to the right-hand screw rule, at the position of OO′, the direction of the magnetic field produced by the straight wire is perpendicular to the line connecting AB to OO′. Judging from the coil labels a→b→c→d→a, by the right-hand rule it can be known that the positive normal corresponding to the current in the abcda direction initially points toward the side of the straight wire AB. Initially, the positive normal of the coil is perpendicular to the magnetic field, and the magnetic flux is zero. If an induced current in the abcda direction is to be produced, according to Lenz's law, the external magnetic flux along this positive normal direction should be decreased, that is, the positive normal of the coil should be turned to the direction opposite to the magnetic field of the straight wire. Comparing in the top view, it can be obtained that the coil needs to rotate counterclockwise by 90° about the OO′ axis.

claims.source: If an induced current in the direction abcda is to be produced, according to Lenz's law, the external magnetic flux should be made to decrease along this positive normal direction.

claims.claim: Making the external magnetic flux decrease along this positive normal direction means making the positive normal of the coil turn to a direction opposite to the magnetic field of the straight wire.
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: That is, making the positive normal of the coil turn to a direction opposite to the magnetic field of the straight wire.

claims.claim: The coil needs to rotate 90° counterclockwise about the OO′ axis.
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: The coil needs to rotate 90° counterclockwise about the OO′ axis
